question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A broth of a boy
solution:
The correct answer is **"A lively, energetic young person."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "a broth of a boy" **is used to describe a young person who is full of energy and enthusiasm. (एक ऐसे युवा व्यक्ति का वर्णन करना जो ऊर्जा और उत्साह से भरा है)

 
 
• **Example**: *It's hard to imagine just by looking at him that this tousle-haired **broth of a bo**__y could be one of the greatest scientific minds in the country.*
 
 
 
• The word** "broth"** in this context means a mixture or combination of different qualities.
 
• This idiom is typically used in a positive way to describe someone who is lively and fun to be around.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
